Claim 1 (Currently amended): A preventing or treating agent for glaucoma comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, __wherein the agent is administered to a subject having glaucoma or at risk of developing glaucoma__.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): A preventing or treating agent for ocular hypertension comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, __wherein the agent is administered to a subject having ocular hypertension or at risk of developing ocular hypertension__.

Claim 3 (Previously presented): A composition for eye drops comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof and a pharmaceutically accepted carrier.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): A method for __treating__ glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered __to a subject having glaucoma__.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): A method for __treating__ ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered __to a subject having ocular hypertension__.

Claim 9 (Previously presented): A method for treating glaucoma comprising administering (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof to a subject in need thereof.

Claim 10 (Previously presented): A method for treating ocular hypertention comprising administering (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof to a subject in need thereof.

Claim 11 (Cancelled).

Claim 12 (Previously presented): A method for reducing intraocular pressure from the normal level, which method comprises administering a combination of (S)-(-)-l-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine, or its salt, and phosphoric acid, or a salt thereof, to a person having normal intraocular pressure.
